name: Benson Muller
source:
The royal painter of Volcano Kingdom. Him demonstrating his outstanding ability in painting has led them to become an apprentice of a royal painter at a young age. He earns a living through making commercial paintings in his spare time.

As a former refugee of the Heathrott War, he has witnessed horrible things that make him hate war. He often prays for peace to continue. 

He is tired of commercial paintings and  hopes to have enough money saved one day to travel everywhere and paint about the things he is interested in.

[Edited from in-game bio]
